title: Three optimized assays for the evaluation of compounds that can rescue p53 mutants
protocol: Thaw the purified p53 DBD protein solution and place it on ice.
Dilute p53 DBD using 4°C storage buffer (20 mM Tris, 150 mM NaCl, and 10 mM DTT, pH 7.6) to a final concentration of 10 μM (about 0.2 mg/mL).
Exchange the buffer with HEPES buffer (20 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, pH 7.5) by dialysis for 16–20 h.
Dilute ATO in HEPES buffer pre-cooled to 4°C to a final concentration of 1.25 mM.
Add purified p53 DBD, ATO, and HEPES buffer into a pre-cooled PCR tube at a molar ratio of 1:20 for p53 DBD to ATO.
Mix gently and spin down the solution using refrigerated microcentrifuge (100 × g, 4°C, 5 s).
Incubate the solution at 4°C for 16–20 hours.
Prepare a 25× working solution of SYPRO Orange by diluting the 5000× stock solution with HEPES buffer in a ratio of 1:200.
Add 8 μL of 25× SYPRO Orange to the 32 μL solution and mix gently.
Pipette 30 μL of the resulting solution into three wells of a pre-cooled PCR plate.
Seal the plate with optical sealing foil.
Spin the solution to the bottom of the plate using small benchtop centrifuge.
Set the detection format to the SYPRO® Orange format (FAM (492 nm) and ROX (610 nm)).
Place the plate into an RT-PCR instrument.
Run a temperature gradient from 20°C to 85°C at 2°C per min, reading the SYPRO® Orange fluorescence intensity every 0.2°C.
Export the .ixo file from LightCycler® 480 software.
Open the exported .ixo file in Roche Protein Melting software.
Click ‘Add Analysis’ button under the ‘Analyse’ tab.
Obtain the calculated Tm values in the .csv file.
Export the calculated Tm in .csv file.
Seed H1299 cells into 6-well plates with 1.0 x 10^6 cells and 3 mL of complete DMEM medium per well, one day before starting the protocol.
Incubate the seeded cells for 16–20 hours to reach around 50% confluence on day 1.
Transfect the cells with the p53 expression plasmid (2.5 μg plasmid per well) according to the manufacturer’s protocol of Lipofectamine 2000 reagent on day 1.
Dilute ATO stock with growth medium to a concentration of 100 μg/mL.
Add diluted ATO to each well to achieve a final concentration of 1 μg/mL.
Incubate the cells for 16–20 hours after gentle shaking.
Wash the cells with cold PBS on day 3.
Lysate the cells with 1 mL of 4°C NP40 buffer.
Collect the cell lysate in a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube.
Sonicate the cell lysate for 3 cycles at 200 watts with 2 s ON and 2 s OFF on ice.
Shake the cell lysate for 10 minutes on ice.
Spin the lysate at 16,100 × g for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Collect 20 μL of supernatant as an input sample.
Add 20 μL protein G beads and 1–3 μg PAb1620 antibody to 450 μL supernatant.
Rotate the mixture for 2 hours at 4°C.
Centrifuge the mixture at 16,100 × g for 5 seconds using a refrigerated microcentrifuge.
Remove the supernatant carefully with a pipette.
Wash the beads with 1 mL of NP40 buffer at 20°C–25°C.
Centrifuge again at 16,100 × g for 5 seconds and remove the supernatant carefully.
Add 20 μL of 2× SDS loading buffer to the pellet.
Heat the sample at 95°C–100°C for 5 min, followed by immunoblotting.
Seed H1299 cells into 96-well plates with 3.0 x 10^4 cells and 100 μL of medium per well one day before starting the protocol.
Co-transfect the cells with the p53-expression plasmid, luciferase reporter plasmid and Renilla plasmid using FuGENE®6 transfection reagent.
Mix 3 μL FuGENE®6 transfection reagent with 50 μL Opti-MEM in a 300 μL tube by gently pipetting.
Incubate the mixture for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Add the 53 μL solution to the plasmid mixture and mix by gently pipetting.
Incubate the resulting transfection mixture for 15 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Add 1 mL of 20°C–25°C DMEM medium to the transfection mixture and mix thoroughly by pipetting.
Use the thoroughly mixed solution to replace all the culture medium in the wells of the pre-seeded cells (100 μL per well).
On day 2, dilute ATO stock resolution with growth medium to a concentration of 3 μg/mL.
Add 50 μL diluted ATO to each well to achieve a final concentration of 1 μg/mL.
On day 3, detect luciferase signal using a Dual Luciferase Reporter Assay Kit (Vazyme, DL101-01).
Remove growth medium from cultured cells.
Rinse cells twice with 1 x PBS.
Add 20 μL 1 x lysis buffer to each well of the 96-well plate.
Shake the plate for 15 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Transfer 4 μL lysates to a white 96-well plate and place the plate into a luminometer with injectors.
Add 20 μL Reaction Buffer II into each well and measure the firefly luciferase signal.
Add 20 μL Stop & Reaction Buffer to each well and measure the Renilla luciferase signal.
